items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: I think they've got this picture of Buddy and myself in there, and then he was a young guy and I was real young.

ctx.x: Yeah. Buddy Rich made a very nice statement in a recent DownBeat, that when he played Chicago, he'd always get out to DeLisa to watch you play the show.

Yeah, right, right. And he used to come out -- but -- and I remember it so much. And I had a picture, but I turned a lot of valuable and beautiful pictures over to the Chicago Historical Society. And I think they've got this picture of Buddy and myself in there, and then he was a young guy and I was real young. And that was some years ago,
